wins_analysis: No wins today. Zero targets were hit out of 1 executed trade, continuing the losing streak that has now persisted for over 10 consecutive weeks.
losses_analysis: The single executed trade (KOTAKBANK BUY at ₹411.22) was a counter-trend BUY in a strong trending_down regime (Nifty -2.1%, ADX 25). The AI report itself explicitly recommended NOT placing this order, noting both setups were counter-trend and below quality thresholds — yet the order was placed anyway. The AI probability was 0% for both setups, which should have been an absolute hard block. This is a discipline/execution failure, not a strategy failure.
regime_impact: The trending_down regime with Nifty -2.1% and ADX 25 was extremely hostile to BUY setups. Only SELL/supply-zone setups aligned with the trend had any chance of working. The strategy scanner found zero SELL setups, which was the correct signal to sit out entirely. Placing a counter-trend BUY trade in this regime directly caused the loss.
